exposure: labor status (mothers in labor vs. not in labor)
outcome: lung function (Forced Expiratory Flow(75) (FEF(75)), FEF(50), FEF(25-75))
cohort: 150 young adults aged 16-18 years who were born extremely prematurely (before 29 weeks of gestation).
finding: Extremely premature infants born to mothers in labor had better small airway function at 16-19 years of age compared to those born to mothers not in labor.
mod_finding: Extremely premature infants born to mothers in labor had better small airway function at 16-19 years of age compared to those born to mothers not in labor.
